decisions.reason: Germany's persistent shortage of healthcare and hospitality workers gives this recruitment service a plausible path to meeting aspirations, and a large firm's slack lets management carry it while results are still uncertain, even though it lies outside the logistics core.

Superyacht crew recruitment is a very small niche far from the firm's warehousing and transport business, so it is unlikely to reach aspiration levels and is a natural candidate for redirecting resources to the core business when management searches for better uses of them.
